cicd_rest_api.name: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CICD) REST API

cicd_spoke.name: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CICD) Spoke

sn_atf.runner.enabled.meaning: Enable test/test suite execution. Defaults to false so tests don't accidentally run on production. Private: does not move between instances in update sets.

sn_atf.schedule.enabled.meaning: Enable scheduled test suite execution. Also requires sn_atf.runner.enabled.

sn_atf.runner.heartbeat.timeout.meaning: Seconds without a heartbeat before a client test runner flips from online to offline (120-1800).

sn_atf.runner.heartbeat.interval.meaning: Seconds between client test runner heartbeats (60-1800).

sn_atf.headless.enabled.meaning: Enable the headless (docker) client test runner.
